sms.title: SMS
sms.label: Contact name
sms.instruction: Share this invitation with your contact. They must send the code from their phone to open the conversation.
sms.invitation: To chat by SMS on DIASPORA, text {{command}} to {{relay}}. This personal code works once before {{expiry}}. Text STOP to end the conversation.
sms.expired: This invitation has expired. You can create another one.
sms.unavailable: The SMS service is currently unavailable.
sms.unavailableHistory: Your message history is still available.
sms.empty: Your conversations will appear here when a contact accepts your invitation.
sms.emptyThread: You can send the first SMS.
sms.stop: Your contact can text STOP to the service number to end the conversation.
sms.disconnectHint: Both of you will stop receiving messages. Your message history will still be available.
sms.shareFailed: Sharing is unavailable. You can select and copy the invitation text.
